p.title: v59.98 BLS reported its four CPI series as failed every refresh after the October 2026 CPI release
p.symptom: From the 2026-11-10T13:51Z refresh on, data.json meta.blsFailedSeries listed cpi, cpiSa, coreCpi and coreCpiSa (reason insufficient_history_for_yoy) and the run summary showed 'BLS official | PARTIAL | series=4/6', while FRED, reading the same CPI months, reported complete.
p.root_cause: BLS never published October 2025 CPI (the 2025 shutdown), so the October 2026 print has no twelve-month comparator. scripts/producer/fred.mjs has classified that as a comparator gap since v58.71; normalizeBlsSeriesResponse had no such branch and recorded each CPI series as a failure, which made the collection 'partial' and fed the failure receipts.
p.fix: normalizeBlsSeriesResponse applies the FRED rule: with no exact prior-year row but months published on both sides of it, the series gets status 'comparator_gap', its value stays missing, it is listed in a new comparatorGaps array instead of failures, and it does not make the collection partial. A history that is simply too short still fails.
p.violated_rule: One source-gap rule per observation family: the FRED and BLS paths read the same CPI months and must classify a never-published comparator month the same way.
p.prevention: ci-data-pipeline-contract-check drives the normalizer with a BLS v1 response in the stored row shape whose 2025-M10 value is '-', and with a short history; the first must be ok with four comparator gaps and no YoY value, the second must still fail.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-data-pipeline-contract-check.mjs exits 0; against the previous normalizer the new check fails with status partial and the four insufficient_history_for_yoy failures seen in production. The live meta clears at the next BLS fetch in Actions (12 h cache).

changelog: **BLS CPI comparator gap is not a failed fetch ({P}):** October 2025 CPI was never published, so the October 2026 print has no year-over-year comparator; the BLS normalizer now classifies that the way the FRED path already did (no value, no failure) instead of reporting four failed CPI series every refresh.
note: v59.98: BLS comparator gap classified like FRED
